input: Source a local frame shop for the kids' artwork

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing how many pieces need framing changes whether this is a one-off visit or a bulk order that requires negotiating a deal.
A tight budget directly limits which shops are viable and whether custom vs. ready-made frames are an option.
The location (neighbourhood or city) determines which shops are actually 'local' and searchable.
Knowing the deadline — e.g. a gift, an event, or no rush — sets the urgency and turnaround time needed from the shop.
Style preferences (rustic, modern, colourful, archival-quality) will filter which shops or framing options are appropriate.
Whether this is for a parent's home, a classroom, or a gift for someone else changes the framing standard and presentation expectations.
Understanding what 'done well' looks like — a vetted shortlist, a booked appointment, or frames in hand — defines the finish line for this task.

gold.taskTitle: Source a local frame shop for kids' artwork
gold.taskDescription: Find and engage a local frame shop to professionally frame children's artwork.

questions.title: How many pieces of artwork need to be framed?
questions.description: Establish the volume of artwork to be framed, as this affects whether a bulk order or single visit is more appropriate.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this framing project?
questions.description: Determine the budget to filter out shops or framing tiers that are not financially viable.

questions.title: Which city or neighbourhood should the shop be near?
questions.description: Pin down the location so that 'local' can be defined and a relevant search can be conducted.

questions.title: Is there a date the framed artwork needs to be ready by?
questions.description: Identify any deadline — such as a birthday, event, or holiday — that sets the required turnaround time.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred frame style or material in mind?
questions.description: Capture aesthetic preferences such as colourful, minimalist, rustic, or archival-quality to narrow down suitable shops.

questions.title: Who will the framed artwork be displayed or gifted to?
questions.description: Clarify whether these frames are for the family home, a classroom, or a gift, as this shapes the expected quality and presentation.

questions.title: What does success look like — a shortlist, booked appointment, or collected frames?
questions.description: Define the endpoint of the task so the plan has a clear and measurable finish line.
